data.name: Aadilah
data.long_meaning: Aadilah is an Arabic name that means one who is just and fair. It is a virtuous name that symbolizes a strong sense of justice and morality.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, justice and fairness are considered essential qualities of a believer, as mentioned in the Quran (4:135).
data.numerology_meaning: Indicates independence, originality, and a pioneering spirit

in_arabic.name: عادلہ
in_arabic.long_meaning: عادلہ هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من词 عَدَل، ومعناه العدل والانصاف، وترجمه إلى المرأة العادلة والصالحة، وذكرت في القرآن الكريم في سياق العدل والقسط، ولها أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: عدیلہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عدیلہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نیک و صالح خاتون، یہ نام عادل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے انصاف اور عدل، اور اسلامی روایت میں اس کا بہت महत्व ہے

in_hindi.name: आदिलह
in_hindi.long_meaning: आदिलह एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है न्यायप्रिय और धार्मिक महिला, यह नाम अदल से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है न्याय और समानता, और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका बहुत महत्व है

in_pashto.name: عدیلہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: عدیلہ د عربی نوم دی چې معنی یې نیکه او صالحه ښځه ده، دا نوم د عدل څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې انصاف او عدل دی، او د افغان/پشتون دود İz میں دا نوم ډیر महत्वपورنه دی

in_english.name: Aadilah
in_english.long_meaning: Aadilah is an Arabic name that means just and righteous woman, derived from the word adl, meaning justice and equality, and has significant importance in Islamic tradition and culture

pronunciation.urdu: عدیلہ کا تلفظ عدیله کے مانند ہے
pronunciation.hindi: आदिलह का उच्चारण आदिलह के समान है
pronunciation.pashto: عدیلہ د تلفظ عدیله په څیر دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Aadilah holds a significant cultural impact as it embodies the Islamic value of fairness and justice. In many Muslim communities, the virtue of justice is highly revered and upheld. Adherents of the faith strive to ensure justice in their personal lives as well as in their communities. The name Aadilah serves as a constant reminder of this Islamic value and serves to inspire and encourage the bearer to uphold fairness and justice in their actions.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aadilah holds great significance as it represents a connection to the divine attribute of justice. In Islamic belief, Allah (God) is the ultimate embodiment of justice. Being called Aadilah is a blessing as it connects the bearer to this divine attribute. Moreover, the name serves as a reminder to strive towards being just and fair in all aspects of life, both in the physical world and in the spiritual realm. It is a constant reminder to live in accordance with divine principles and to uphold the moral values that embody the essence of the Islamic faith.
